system.flavor:
Soften a thrown punch, take a thrown stone on a cushion of shadow, or shade your eyes from a lantern swung in your face. One blow, one moment.

Not enough to stop a falling beam or turn a blade.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: A detected enemy's Action would deal Damage to you. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 1.

surges.html: After the Action, your space provides concealment until the start of your next turn.
Suppress one ordinary visual impairment imposed by that Action until the start of your next turn.
